chapter: Art Hodes, Bechet and Blue Note
title: At Johnson's trio at Kelly's Stables
summary: Tenor player At Johnson hired him through the Rhythm Club for six months at Kelly's Stables at $40 a week.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: This is Tape Four, and we're with Freddie Moore, and we're going back to the Victoria, where you've been working with your trio. You started to work eventually with At Johnson; you freelanced with him.
Who was At Johnson, and what did he play, and how did you start working with him?
At Johnson was a tenor player. He played Blues, he'd sing the Blues. I worked with him down at a club down at... I can't think of the name of that club. At 42nd...44th Street. Kelly's Stables.

Yeah, down there at Kelly's Stables. He had a trio. I've forgot the name of this piano player he had. He had a piano player ...(?)... We were down there I'd say about six months. Kelly's Stables. Pretty nice place. They had different bands...
How was it that you joined up with him, that you met up with him and started playing?

Well, I used to work around different places, club dates and... I would mostly get a lot of work from the Rhythm Club. All the musicians would hang out around the Rhythm Club. John Kirby...not John Kirby... At Johnson used to get work from the Rhythm Club. He had a trio, a set(?) with At Johnson and a piano player. They had a chance to go down to Kelly's Stables, and so he asked me did I want to go down to Kelly's Stables with them, and I said, 'Yeah, I'll go down there.' I think the (?) was paying around forty dollars! Forty dollars a week.
Was this immediately after you left Kirby? Or was this after Kirby, and you'd gone back to the Victoria?
I think this was the period before... We went down to the Victoria in '37, '38...? After... Between...
Between meeting Kirby and actually going back to the Victoria.
Yes. It was after we left, I think it was Kirby... No, it wasn't after that... It will come to me after a while. Just....
